answer: New identities enter through an inlet: at most 50 per epoch, each locking a 60 POA bond as an anchor tied to a behavioral fingerprint of timing and counterparties over a 25-epoch horizon. It unlocks only as the fingerprint matures. A duplicate fingerprint freezes the clone and burns its bond; a rented reputation slashes the renter's anchor too. Forging 1,000 fakes locks 60,000 POA. An honest agent pays once and earns every epoch at no extra cost.
